'''M'iiyoom Onith''', also known as '''Nightlily''', was a sharp-[[tongue]]d [[H'nemthe (species)|H'nemthe]] [[Gender|female]].<ref name="CL 2016" /> In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{FilmDate|IV|1}}</ref> Onith spent [[time]] in the back rooms of [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. The H'nemthe sat in a booth with the [[Gotal]] [[tax collector]] [[Feltipern Trevagg]] and the [[Givin]] [[smuggler]] [[Elis Helrot]]. Not realizing what was at stake, Trevagg attempted to romance Onith<ref name="CL 2016" /> and was laughing with an [[Limb|arm]] around the H'nemthe's shoulder when the local [[moisture farmer]] [[Luke Skywalker]] entered the [[cantina]] with [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and the [[droid]]s [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]]. Onith was also laughing<ref name="ANH" /> and speaking [[H'nemthe (language)|H'nemthe]].<ref name="Language">{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}}</ref>

The pair were still sitting next to Helrot in the back room booth when Skywalker and Kenobi later got into an altercation at the bar with the criminals [[Doctor]] [[Cornelius Evazan]] and [[Ponda Baba]],<ref name="CL 2016" /> after which Trevagg alerted his [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] allies to the [[Jedi]]'s presence.<ref name="Topps">{{Topps|set=2018 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files|cardname=Feltipern Trevagg Cantina Patron|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/170092/cid/11689241}}</ref> Onith had [[Color|brown]] skin, black [[eye]]s, and wore a brown [[Clothing|shawl]] while in the cantina.<ref name="ANH" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Re-shoot mask===
[[File:CantinaCreatureHead-McQuarrie.png|thumb|right|300px|"Creature Cantina Head" by Ralph McQuarrie]]
M'iiyoom Onith first appeared in the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']],<ref name="ANH" /> which was released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> Portrayed by an uncredited<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Phil Tippett]],<ref name="Tom Spina Tippett Confirmation">[[:File:TrevaggAndOnith.png|Message from Tom Spina]] — Used with permission</ref> Onith's mask was created by Tippett<ref name="Spina">{{WebCite|url=http://www.tomspinadesigns.com/restoration/star-wars-props/star-wars-cantina-alien-mask-movie-prop-restoration|text=''Star Wars'' Cantina Alien Mask Movie Prop Restoration|date=2012|work=[http://www.tomspinadesigns.com www.tomspinadesigns.com]|archivedate=20230330071019}}</ref> as one of several aliens to be used<ref name="YouTube">{{YouTube|video=d1AAd1tsPds|text=Star Wars: A New Hope – Cantina Archeology Part 2: Behind The Scenes of the Mos Eisley Cantina – US|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> in a series of supplemental shots filmed for the cantina sequence on a sound stage in Dovington's Hollywood studio between [[January 24]]–[[January 25|25]], 1977.<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars: The Definitive Story Behind the Original Film]]''</ref> The character's shawl was also reused in combination with Trevagg's mask<ref name="Shirt">{{SW|url=news/swca-secrets-of-the-mos-eisley-cantina-panel-liveblog|text=SWCA: Secrets of the Mos Eisley Cantina Panel Liveblog|nolive=1}}</ref> for the character [[Hennet Kayn]] during the shots.<ref name="Kayn">{{SW|url=news/swcc-2019-6-surprises-from-inside-the-mos-eisley-cantina|text=SWCC 2019: 6 Surprises from Inside the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

To make the character's mask, Tippett cast a slip latex copy of makeup artist [[Rick Baker]]'s creepy baby mask from the [[1974]] film [[Wikipedia:It's Alive (1974 film)|''It's Alive'']] and then sculpted Onith's mask on top by layering polyfoam over it and stippling the surface with latex, layers of tissue and cotton, and a large number of dots of texture.<ref name="Spina" /> The final look is thought to have been inspired by a sketch<ref name="YouTube" /> entitled "Cantina Creature Head" that [[Ralph McQuarrie]] originally created for the [[Rodian]] character [[Greedo]].<ref name="Moviemaking">''[[The Moviemaking Magic of Star Wars: Creatures & Aliens]]''</ref>

===Naming and mask reuse===
{{Quote|When we first saw Feltiperrn in the cantina, he was snuggling up to a beak-nosed alien who was giggling up a storm. Beauty is in the eye of the beholder, of course, but this comely alien was given the unflattering on-set nickname of Yam Nose.|Author [[Pablo Hidalgo]], discussing the creation of M'iiyoom Onith|<ref name="shedding">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref>}}
[[File:YamnoseRepair.png|thumb|left|300px|Repair work was done on the Yam Nose mask in 2012.]]
Given the on-set nickname of Yam Nose, Onith was intended to receive the proper name of Yamnoss, but the idea never came to fruition,<ref name="shedding" /> although a [[Yamnoss|H'nemthe character]] in [[1978]]'s ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' that reused Onith's mask was eventually given the name.<ref name="Who's Who">{{SW|url=news/the-star-wars-holiday-special-cantina-we-may-not-thrive-friend-but-we-survive-friend|text=''The Star Wars Holiday Special'' Cantina: Who's Who|int=The Star Wars Holiday Special Cantina: Who's Who|nolive=1}}</ref> Onith's mask was also reused for a [[Unidentified H'nemthe|H'nemthe character]] that appeared in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="shedding" /> In [[2012]], the original mask was in very good condition and was cleaned and restored by Maria Teran of [[Tom Spina]] Designs, who only needed to add and paint a few patches where there was missing latex.<ref name="Spina" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Onith was identified in the [[2016]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Location'']].<ref name="CL 2016" /> The [[M'iiyoom Onith/Legends|character's name]] originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used on a card in the [[1995]] ''[[Premiere Limited]]'' set for the ''[[Star Wars Customizable Card Game]]'' produced by [[Decipher]]<ref name="cardgame">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=M'iiyoom Onith}}</ref>
